permissions.name: storage
permissions.description: Store data locally in the browser.
permissions.whyItMatters: Local to the extension; low inherent exposure.

permissions.name: unlimitedStorage
permissions.description: Store data without the usual quota.
permissions.whyItMatters: Consumes disk space but grants no extra data access.

permissions.name: alarms
permissions.description: Schedule code to run at set times or intervals.
permissions.whyItMatters: Enables background scheduling; content depends on the code.

permissions.name: idle
permissions.description: Detect when the machine is idle.
permissions.whyItMatters: Reveals machine usage state, not page content.

permissions.name: contextMenus
permissions.description: Add items to the browser context menu.

permissions.name: notifications
permissions.whyItMatters: Can be used for social engineering content.

permissions.name: activeTab
permissions.description: Temporary access to the current tab on explicit user action.

permissions.name: tabs
permissions.description: Read the URL, title and status of open tabs.

permissions.name: scripting
permissions.description: Inject scripts and CSS into pages (with host access).
permissions.whyItMatters: Powerful when combined with broad host permissions.

permissions.name: downloads
permissions.whyItMatters: Can observe and alter what the user downloads.

permissions.name: downloads.open
permissions.whyItMatters: Can open files without further confirmation.

permissions.name: clipboardRead
permissions.whyItMatters: Clipboard often contains passwords and sensitive text.

permissions.name: cookies
permissions.description: Read and modify cookies for permitted hosts.

permissions.name: bookmarks
permissions.whyItMatters: Bookmarks can reveal interests; modifications can redirect navigation.

permissions.name: webRequest
permissions.description: Observe (and in MV2, block/modify) network requests.
permissions.whyItMatters: Full visibility of browsing traffic metadata.

permissions.name: proxy
permissions.whyItMatters: All traffic can be routed through a chosen server.

permissions.name: debugger
permissions.description: Attach the Chrome debugger to pages.
permissions.whyItMatters: Full page inspection and control; Chrome shows a persistent warning bar.

permissions.name: nativeMessaging
permissions.description: Exchange messages with a native application installed on the computer.
permissions.whyItMatters: Bridges the browser sandbox to desktop programs.

permissions.name: management
permissions.whyItMatters: Can observe and (with user action) disable other extensions.

permissions.name: identity
permissions.description: Access the user's identity/email via Google.
permissions.whyItMatters: Exposes the account email and OAuth grants.

permissions.name: declarativeNetRequest
permissions.description: Block or modify network requests via static rules (MV3).
permissions.whyItMatters: Network interception capability within rule limits.

permissions.name: declarativeNetRequestWithHostAccess
permissions.description: declarativeNetRequest with the extension's host access.
permissions.whyItMatters: Network interception scoped to granted hosts.

permissions.name: contentSettings
permissions.description: Modify site content settings (cookies, JS, plugins).

permissions.name: desktopCapture
permissions.whyItMatters: Captures everything on screen when invoked.

permissions.name: tabCapture
permissions.description: Capture a tab's audio and video.

permissions.name: printerProvider
permissions.whyItMatters: Handles print jobs and their content.

permissions.name: offscreen
permissions.typicalUse: DOM work without a visible page.

permissions.name: userScripts
permissions.whyItMatters: Arbitrary script injection on granted hosts.

permissions.name: readingList
permissions.description: Read and modify the reading list.

permissions.name: fileBrowserHandler
permissions.description: Act on files in the ChromeOS file browser.
